title: Meta-SecAlign: Training LLMs against Prompt Injection for Robust Agents
abstract: arXiv:2507.02735v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prompt injection attacks, where untrusted data contains an injected prompt to manipulate the system, have been listed as the top security threat to AI agents. By fine-tuning on simulated prompt injections, SecAlign, a leading open defense, reports LLMs with good test-time robustness and negligible benign utility drop. By scaling up training and evaluations, however, we find that SecAlign actually suffers from significant utility degradation, especially in agentic tasks where the threat of prompt injection is prominent. Motivated by this, we propose Meta-SecAlign for utility-preserving defense by (1) randomized injection position during training to avoid shortcut learning and (2) self-generated responses as high-quality in-distribution training labels. Across general knowledge, instruction following, and agentic workflows (on tool-calling and web-navigation), Meta-SecAlign maintains almost all the undefended LLM's utility while

translated_title: Meta-SecAlign：通过对抗提示注入训练大语言模型以构建鲁棒智能体
translated_abstract: 提示注入攻击是指不可信数据中包含注入的提示用以操纵系统，该攻击已被列为AI智能体面临的首要安全威胁。SecAlign作为一种领先的开放防御方法，通过对模拟提示注入进行微调，据报告能使大语言模型获得良好的测试时鲁棒性，且良性效用损失可忽略不计。然而，通过扩大训练和评估规模，我们发现SecAlign实际上存在显著的效用下降，尤其是在提示注入威胁突出的智能体任务中。受此启发，我们提出了Meta-SecAlign以实现保持效用的防御，其核心包括：(1) 在训练过程中随机化注入位置以避免捷径学习；(2) 使用模型自生成的响应作为高质量的分布内训练标签。在通用知识、指令遵循和智能体工作流（包括工具调用和网页导航）等任务上，Meta-SecAlign在保持几乎全部未防御大语言模型效用的同时……
tldr: Meta-SecAlign通过训练时随机化注入位置避免捷径学习、并使用模型自生成的高质量分布内训练标签，在防御提示注入攻击的同时几乎完整保留了大语言模型的原始性能。
